title: GitHub App Configuration Schema
description: Schema for Rig Relay GitHub App local configuration. All secret fields are references (keychain://, env://, or file:// outside repo) — never raw secret values.

app_id.description: GitHub App ID from app settings page

client_id.description: GitHub App client ID (Iv1... format). Required only if user authorization/OAuth flow is needed.

app_slug.description: URL-friendly app slug from GitHub App settings

webhook_url.description: Public URL where GitHub delivers webhooks. For local dev, this is a tunnel URL.

setup_url.description: Optional setup URL shown during app installation

callback_url.description: Optional OAuth callback URL for user authorization

webhook_secret_ref.description: Reference to webhook secret. Must use one of: keychain://service/account, env://VAR_NAME, or file:///absolute/path/outside/repo. Never raw secret value.

private_key_ref.description: Reference to GitHub App private key (PEM). Must use one of: keychain://service/account, env://VAR_NAME, or file:///absolute/path/outside/repo. Never raw PEM text. File must be outside repository with 600 permissions.

default_permission_profile.description: Default permission profile ID to request during installation

allowed_repositories.description: Pre-configured list of repositories to authorize. Can be updated via installation_repositories webhook.

token_cache_policy.description: Policy for installation access token cache (memory-only)

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live for cached tokens. Must be under GitHub's 3600-second expiry. Default: 55 minutes.

max_payload_bytes.description: Maximum webhook payload size in bytes. Default: 5 MB (under GitHub's 25 MB cap).

store_raw_payload.description: Whether to store raw webhook payloads. Default: false (content-light event ledger only).

dedupe_window_days.description: Number of days to retain delivery IDs for deduplication.

require_signature.description: Must be true in production. Set to false only for local testing without a webhook secret.

frontend_projection_policy.description: Policy for frontend projection of GitHub data

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last config update

not.description: Reserved for future pattern-based secret detection
